about: Findings of scripts/prepush-scan.mjs that a person reviewed and accepted. Each entry holds for one file with exactly this SHA-256 and one kind of finding; if the file changes, the scanner reports it again. The values themselves are not written here, for the same reason the scanner never prints them.
